title: Refuse to Rule
summary: A leadership practice of declining to make decisions for teams when they have the capability to decide themselves, using procedural guidance instead to prevent learned helplessness and build team ownership.
when-to-read: Read this when you're managing teams and wondering whether you should make a decision for them, or when you notice your teams are becoming dependent on you for approval. If you're looking for how to actually make better decisions as a leader, see decision-making articles instead; this is about when NOT to decide.
